ofertas.descripcion:
Quote request: pharmacy website and app
Oct 31, 2026 · @Michael Stander
I'd like a quote to build a website and installable phone app (PWA) for a small independent
pharmacy. It has an online shop, prescription uploads, deliveries with drivers, and a staff
dashboard. The features are listed below; the last section says what the quote should
include.
Customer side
1. Online shop with categories, search, product photos and specials.
2. Product rules: some medicines can't be sold online or put on special; scheduled
medicines need a prescription.
3. Cart and checkout with three options: delivery, collection at the counter, and drivethrough.
4. Delivery address picked on a map, with a maximum distance from the pharmacy, a
delivery fee and a free-delivery minimum.
5. Customer accounts: profile, order history and order status.
6. Customers can cancel an order themselves.
7. Prescription upload (photo or PDF), stored securely.
8. Bookings for clinic times (for example vaccinations).
9. Reminder
I need a packaging designer to create a coffee bag design, with a budget of $200. The design should be full packaging wrap, dielines are provided.

ofertas.titulo: Lead Graphic Designer for a High-End Collegiate Apparel Brand
ofertas.descripcion: We are launching a premium three-piece collegiate apparel collection for a prestigious medical batch and need a Lead Apparel Graphic Designer for a long-term partnership. Our goal is to transform cliché university merchandise into a minimalist luxury fashion brand with Old Money, Dark Academia, and Quiet Luxury influences. The debut collection includes a heavyweight hoodie, crewneck, and collared rugby sweater, with rapid expansion planned across engineering, business, and other top-tier university cohorts. We need sophisticated, clean, clever typographic designs that establish our core visual DNA and communicate faculty and batch heritage without crowded or cliché streetwear graphics.

I’m looking for a Squarespace website designer to create a professional website using the Squarespace platform and incorporating the existing squarespace site I already have into a new, broader website.

ofertas.titulo: Captura De Imagem E Vídeo Com Edição E Gestão De Página No Instagram
ofertas.descripcion: Preciso de alguém para captar imagens e vídeos, realizar a edição desses materiais e também cuidar da gestão da minha página do Instagram. O profissional deve ser capaz de produzir conteúdo visual de qualidade e administrar as postagens, interações e estratégias da rede social.

ofertas.titulo: New Brand Launch Content Creation and Social Media Sales Data Analysis
ofertas.descripcion: I'm launching a new brand and need a designer with launch experience to create content and analyze online social media and sales data. The work should support an effective brand launch and inform content decisions using performance insights. We sell high end cashmere clothing

ofertas.titulo: VFX Rotoscoping and Compositing for 45-Second Character Videos
ofertas.descripcion: I need VFX artists to rotoscope and composite high-quality 45-second videos featuring one character across a variety of 3D environments. The environments will be created by VFX artists using Blender, After Effects, and related tools. CGI only; no AI.
